name: Stateful-Looking Binary Constraint
description: Replaces a well-known number theory trope (product of two integers from a small set is a perfect square iff they are equal) with a symmetric 2x2 linear system whose uniqueness of solution depends on the determinant. This forces the model to algebraically evaluate the constraint rather than relying on memorized competitive programming tropes, ensuring only models that genuinely trace the algorithmic logic succeed.
